description_html:
Documentation

3D Model Application Instruction

 

Introduction

This Wind-Up Walking Mechanism is a fun and interactive addition to your 3D-printed models, perfect for bringing characters like cute ghosts and grim reapers to life with just a wind-up. The smooth, burr-free surface ensures safe handling, especially for children. The compact design makes it easy to carry and enjoy anytime, anywhere.
Ideal for DIY projects, this mechanism encourages hands-on creativity while adding movement to your models. Simply attach it to the base, wind it up, and watch it walk across any flat surface!
Note：Be careful not to overwind the mechanism, as this may cause damage.

 

Product Feature

  • Simulates Human Gait: The mechanism replicates a natural walking motion, allowing your models to step forward smoothly. 
  • Compact and Lightweight: Easily fits into small models, enabling portable, on-the-go fun. 
  • Customizable for Creativity : Ideal for 3D-printed characters or DIY projects, allowing unique personalization. 
  • Eco-Friendly Material : Made from eco-friendly plastic, it aligns with sustainable practices while providing durability. 
  • Reliable and Durable Built for repeated use, it maintains quality performance with each wind-up.
